releases.name: Version 1.3.2
releases.bodyZh: ロシア語訳を追加しました @HanSoloCh

releases.name: Version 1.3.1
releases.body: * Achievements now have Chinese translations by @SanBaiMing in https://github.com/LeeSpork/Bruce-Saves-the-Worlds/pull/10
releases.bodyZh: * 成就には現在、@SanBaiMingによる中国語訳があります https://github.com/LeeSpork/Bruce-Saves-the-Worlds/pull/10

releases.name: Version 1.3.0
releases.body:
- Modelled the radio communications and raised Corey.
- Fixed the gravity inside a location.
- Fixed a misplaced word (Thanks Fenna!)
- Almost certainly the last update before the jam deadline.
releases.bodyZh:
- ラジオ通信をモデル化し、Coreyを救出した。
- ある場所内の重力を修正した。
- 適切でない単語を修正（Fennaさん、ありがとう！）
- ジャムの締め切り直前の最後のアップデートであることがほぼ確実。

releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
- Added another Easter egg
- Added achievements
- Shiplog entries can now have their locations marked on your HUD
- HUD and ship notifications should now be translated
- Edited a line of dialogue

Mod also has a thumbnail now.
releases.bodyZh:
- 追加のイースター Eggが追加されました
- 成就が追加されました
- 航行記録のエントリには、現在位置がHUDに表示されるようになりました
- HUDおよび船の通知は現在翻訳されています
- 台詞の1行が編集されました

MODには現在サムネイルがあります。

releases.name: Version 1.1.3
releases.body:
- Removed an unobtainable ship log fact
- Black hole swallows the player more reliably
- Ship now gets black hole warnings too
- Minor wording changes in ship log
releases.bodyZh:
- 手に入らない航行記録の事実を削除
- ブラックホールがプレイヤーをより確実に飲み込む
- 船もブラックホールの警告を受け取るようになりました
- 航行記録の表現を少し変更

releases.name: Version 1.1.2
releases.body:
- The player can no longer oversleep the destruction of the planet and get trapped in a coma forever.
- Fixed a mistake that caused an audio cue to be spammed.
- Righted a wrong that could cause certain notifications to be activated when they are no longer relevant.

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
## Additions
- Bruce now has new dialogue after you complete the main objective of the mod, better wrapping up the story.
- Gave certain epilogue objects giant light beams to make them more obvious.

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body:
- Did Ship Log Rumor Mode properly
- Marked the "Lore Tracker" mod as incompatible

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body:
## Additions
* Added `chinese_simple` translation by @SanBaiMing

## Hotfixes
* Bruce will no longer take you hostage if you talk to the second version of him a second time
* You can no longer win by doing nothing but dying in extreme circumstances
